title: Can I make the face window fill into the outline in textbox?

posts.author: Zandrinn
posts.body: Hey everyone! I'm working on a project in RPG Maker and I was wondering if there's a way to make the face window bigger so it fits perfectly with the outline of the textbox. I'd love to enlarge the face image so it takes up more space without messing with the text area. Does anyone know of a plugin or method to resize the face window like this, or do you have any other way to fix it ? Any information would really help me, thank you.
